candidates.change_summary: Remove the state update `_ownerOf[id] = to;` so transferFrom no longer changes the token owner.
Assign `from` instead of `to` to `_ownerOf[id]`, keeping ownership with the sender.
Remove the WRONG_FROM check so transferFrom succeeds for arbitrary `from`, overwriting `_ownerOf[id]` even when `from` is not the owner.
Remove the NOT_AUTHORIZED check so any caller can transfer any token, changing `_ownerOf[id]` where the original would revert.
Remove the INVALID_RECIPIENT check so transferring to address(0) sets `_ownerOf[id] = 0` instead of reverting.
Remove the state update `_ownerOf[id] = to;` in _mint so minted tokens have no owner recorded.
Remove the ALREADY_MINTED check so re-minting an existing token overwrites `_ownerOf[id]` with the new recipient.
Assign `msg.sender` instead of `to` as the owner of the newly minted token.
